summary: I tried to refute the Qwen3-Coder-Next record and could not. Every identity, capability and benchmark fact I checked holds against primary sources. The repo author is Qwen, createdAt is 2026-01-30T15:08:18Z, and the tech report was committed 2026-02-03 (11:19Z and 16:46Z). Config and card values match. The Apache-2.0 license appears both in the card front matter and in the API tags. The card states the model is non-thinking only, and the chat template has no enable_thinking or think branch. Tool calling uses the Qwen3-Coder XML format, and tool results go back as tool_response inside a user turn. All tech report numbers in Tables 3 to 7 match exactly. All Artificial Analysis (AA) values come from the object with slug qwen3-coder-next (isReasoning false, intelligenceIndex null, releaseDate 2026-02-03). All seven cited vLLM issues exist, are open, and their titles and dates match. The cited llama.cpp issue also exists and is open. vLLM v0.33.0 registry.py:118 and :735 and tool_parsers/__init__.py:206 and :217 match. In llama.cpp b12418, llama-arch.cpp:42 and the Qwen3-Coder handler in chat.cpp match. One small correction: in the llama.cpp section, the official Qwen Q4_K_M is given as 45.19 GiB. The API gives 48.41 GB = 45.09 GiB, as the checkpoints list already says. The 45.2 GiB figure belongs to unsloth's Q4_K_M (48.53 GB). Other minor points: the card's vLLM and SGLang text says 'tensor parallel on 4 GPUs' but the command uses TP 2. The record's '2+ GPUs' wording is fine. The card's scaffold list also includes Qoder and Trae. Gaps: I did not open the qwen.ai blog or the card's benchmark images. Apart from AA, there is no independent check of SWE-bench or Terminal-Bench scores, so the vendor numbers stay self-reported. The HF org has no verified badge (isVerified false). Files: $SCRATCH/fc_qcn/tr.txt (tech report text), $SCRATCH/fc_qcn/tpl.jinja, $SCRATCH/fc_qcn/aa.html.

verdicts.claim: Official Qwen repo; HF createdAt 2026-01-30T15:08:18Z, lastModified 2026-02-03; tech report committed 2026-02-03; inside 2025-11-15..2026-11-15
verdicts.correction: The API gives author Qwen. The org overview shows isVerified false, 469 models, 116473 followers and plan team. gh api commits for qwen3_coder_next_tech_report.pdf show 2026-02-03T11:19:53Z 'Add files via upload' and 16:46:01Z 'Update tech report'.

verdicts.claim: License Apache-2.0 (card front matter and license_link)
verdicts.correction: The API tags also include license:apache-2.0. The LICENSE file text itself was not read.

verdicts.claim: 79,674,391,296 BF16 params; card '80B total, 3B activated', 79B non-embedding; safetensors 159.36 GB / 148.41 GiB; routed experts about 77.3B
verdicts.correction: Measured sum 159,358,031,480 B = 148.41 GiB. 48x512x3x2048x512 = 77.31B, which is 97.0% of the total.

verdicts.claim: Architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM, 48 layers, hidden 2048, full_attention_interval 4, 16 Q / 2 KV heads, head_dim 256, partial_rotary 0.25, DeltaNet 32 V / 16 QK heads dim 128, conv 4, 512 experts top-10 + 1 shared, moe_intermediate 512, no sliding window, rope_theta 5e6, rope_scaling null
Context 262,144 native, no YaRN documented; card suggests 32,768 on OOM
Text-only modality
verdicts.correction: There is no vision config and the pipeline_tag is text-generation.

verdicts.claim: Non-thinking only; no enable_thinking toggle in template; no reasoning parser needed
verdicts.correction: The card note is quoted verbatim. Grepping the template for 'think' returns no matches.

verdicts.claim: Tool calling via Qwen3-Coder XML (<tool_call><function=..><parameter=..>), tool results as <tool_response> inside a user turn; repo ships qwen3coder_tool_parser_vllm.py and qwen3_coder_detector_sgl.py
verdicts.correction: Template line 66 holds the format instruction, lines 85-94 render tool_calls, and lines 99-105 wrap tool messages in user and tool_response.

verdicts.claim: vLLM v0.33.0 registry.py:118 Qwen3NextForCausalLM and :735 Qwen3NextMTP; tool_parsers/__init__.py:206 qwen3_coder and qwen3_xml -> Qwen3EngineToolParser
llama.cpp b12418 llama-arch.cpp:42 qwen3next; chat.cpp picks the Qwen3-Coder handler on <tool_call>/<function=/<parameter=
verdicts.correction: The handler sits at about lines 1420-1428. It also excludes templates without newlines between tags, which does not apply here.

verdicts.correction: The official Qwen Q4_K_M is 48.41 GB = 45.09 GiB. The 45.20 GiB figure is unsloth's Q4_K_M (48.53 GB). This is a small internal inconsistency and does not change the conclusion.

verdicts.claim: Cited vLLM issues #34322, #57699, #65774, #57541, #59248, #62320, #66423 and llama.cpp #30357 exist, open, as described
